scientific_integrity: All norm, essential-norm, and testing-locus assertions are deduced analytically; tests are only finite consistency checks. The classical Hilbert and Poisson identities and prior single-log ratio are credited.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to nonconstant inner B with B(0)=0 and the canonical strip logarithm; no classification of all unbounded SRKT symbols. Finite computational checks do not prove infinite-dimensional statements. An equivalent result in older BMOA/inner-composition literature cannot be excluded.
title: Inner pullbacks of a strip logarithm: exact Hankel, essential, and Garsia norms
